_lorenz_161: Day 10: Benedikt Lorenz reached V-F11 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

Benedikt Lorenz made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration. After the loss of Grey Mill, Benedikt Lorenz helped stack spare sandbags at V-F11. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Karel Hier and Benedikt Lorenz compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
The last of the jam was shared by scraping it onto a biscuit. Benedikt Lorenz approved the method.
Benedikt Lorenz bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage.
A replacement turned out to be from Dunmarrow too. Benedikt Lorenz and the newcomer argued about the same bakery for half the night.

During a lull at Hill 304, Benedikt Lorenz called across from the Concord line. Tobias "Ash" Mrsmidgeyt answered from the Hegemony side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet.
Benedikt Lorenz practised asking for bread in the local language. The dugout supplied an audience and several confidently incorrect pronunciations.
abdul22mujtaba: Viktor Mujtaba was a clockmaker in Dunmarrow until the posters went up. He came to R-R7 with a child's drawing of a horse, and within a day the whole squad knew that he whistles the same four notes over and over.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Viktor Mujtaba helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Viktor Mujtaba found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Viktor Mujtaba shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
The cook borrowed Viktor Mujtaba's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.
Viktor Mujtaba bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage.

Viktor Mujtaba was found at the bottom of the trench at R-R7, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Tobias "Ash" Alierayyagiy of the Concord (@alierayyagiyanik). Viktor Mujtaba was killed outright at R-R7, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Tobias "Ash" Alierayyagiy of the Concord (@alierayyagiyanik).
Tobias "Parson" Mujtaba asked about Viktor Mujtaba on arriving at R-R7. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
In reserve, Tobias "Parson" Mujtaba slept nine hours in a barn. He dreamt of nothing, which was the best part.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Tobias "Parson" Mujtaba pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.
Tobias "Parson" Mujtaba lost a boot in the trench. Gideon "Parson" Gibbons found it, stuffed it with dry socks, and gave it back without a word.
akacandysama: Gustav "Parson" Akacandysama arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
Gustav "Parson" Akacandysama walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Gustav "Parson" Akacandysama carried three men out of R-R11 on a stretcher. One of them thanked him. Two could not. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Gustav "Parson" Akacandysama folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Gustav "Parson" Akacandysama wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
Gustav "Parson" Akacandysama carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished.
Gustav "Parson" Akacandysama and Marek Elox spent an hour hunting rats with a bucket and a piece of cheese. Score at dusk: rats 4, soldiers 1.
Gustav "Parson" Akacandysama and Marek Badbadmannnn found a cat in the ruins at Verdel Ridge and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Marek.
Gustav "Parson" Akacandysama and Marek Elox carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Gustav "Parson" Akacandysama put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.
bachir_abderahmane: Benedikt "Tin" Abderahmane introduced himself as a railway porter from Stoneyford. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Benedikt "Tin" Abderahmane helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Benedikt "Tin" Abderahmane tried to remember the price of a loaf in Stoneyford. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.

Benedikt "Tin" Abderahmane owes Felix "Mud" Shiniestmeat so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full. Mail came up the line with a letter for Benedikt "Tin" Abderahmane. Benedikt "Tin" Abderahmane read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Benedikt "Tin" Abderahmane watched the enemy lines change the guard at U-F17 every two hours, to the minute. At the next change, Tobias "Whistle" Train was badly wounded.

Benedikt "Tin" Abderahmane saw Albin Mit freeze up on the fire step at the Brickworks. Tin said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough. Mail came up the line with a letter for Benedikt "Tin" Abderahmane. Benedikt "Tin" Abderahmane read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A parcel came for Benedikt "Tin" Abderahmane that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: two knitted scarves. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping. The runner said a letter for Benedikt "Tin" Abderahmane had come up with the ammunition. Benedikt "Tin" Abderahmane went to get it before the ammunition.
Benedikt "Tin" Abderahmane saw a hare run the whole length of no man's land and nobody on either side fired at it.
boxknight04: Nobody asked Anselm Boxknight why he came. Nobody in S-R2 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

The gun crews at S-R2 and the next post fired together on a count of five. Caught between the two guns, Ulrich Samuelbujore was badly wounded. Blackwater Canal has been won. Anselm Boxknight listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Anselm Boxknight felt a hard tug at his hip at S-R2. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Jonas "Parson" Underthrone of the Concord (@underthrone99). Anselm Boxknight walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Anselm Boxknight walked back up the communication trench to S-R2, slower than before, but on his own feet.
Anselm Boxknight was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-R2. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Quentin The of the Concord (@noah_the_0ne).
Anselm Boxknight tried to stay at his post with the wound. By evening he could not stand, and the bearers took him back.
Anselm Boxknight spent a week on a stretcher in the corridor of the aid post. Today he stood up, held the wall, and walked out to S-R2.
Anselm Boxknight fired at a movement across the wire at S-R2. The man went down: Roland "Mole" Tuckerdesave, badly wounded.
Anselm Boxknight tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread.
carnahanwiley: Isidor "Ghost" Carnahanwile came from Brennmoor, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
Isidor "Ghost" Carnahanwile and Casimir Sky sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.
The gun team argued about who carried the heaviest load. Isidor "Ghost" Carnahanwile offered to swap loads. The argument ended at once.

Isidor "Ghost" Carnahanwile saw shapes coming through the gap in the wire and fired along it. The shapes went to ground. One of them was Felix Wyatt, grazed. A bullet grazed Isidor "Ghost" Carnahanwile's ribs at R-S14. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss of the Concord (@eddholmesss). The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-S14 changed before the cheering ended. Isidor "Ghost" Carnahanwile shouldered another load.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Isidor "Ghost" Carnahanwile in the open at R-S14. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Clement Metropolitan of the Concord (@metropolitan_wr). Isidor "Ghost" Carnahanwile was killed outright at R-S14, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Clement Metropolitan of the Concord (@metropolitan_wr).

Gideon "Bones" Carnahanwile asked about Isidor "Ghost" Carnahanwile on arriving at R-S14. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another. The clerk counted the names twice. Gideon "Bones" Carnahanwile is number 493 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill has been won. Gideon "Bones" Carnahanwile listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Severin Polipoart fell asleep on watch. Gideon "Bones" Carnahanwile took over without waking Severin, and told the sergeant nothing.
Gideon "Bones" Carnahanwile and Anselm "Lucky" Kevinrey compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Gideon "Bones" Carnahanwile asked to see the second one. The barber laughed.
Gideon "Bones" Carnahanwile fired at the enemy dawn watch from R-S14. Otto "Shadow" Anderson was badly wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
Gideon "Bones" Carnahanwile kept Benedikt Datoneperson awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Bones could have walked there blind.
Gideon "Bones" Carnahanwile shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter.
conors_site: Konrad Site arrived on Day 10 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

Konrad Site shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter. Mail came up the line with a letter for Konrad Site. Konrad Site read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Konrad Site helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Someone in T-F15 asked Konrad Site about Oakmere. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted.
A bullet hit Konrad Site's belt buckle at T-F15 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Karel "Spark" Freejstax of the Concord (@freejstax).
The medics cleaned Konrad Site's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at T-F15.

A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Konrad Site aimed a step ahead and fired: Roland Stickus, grazed. Konrad Site counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Ivo Jeff was badly wounded.

The Concord raiders came over at T-F15 in the middle of the night. Konrad Site met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Matthias Tommaso of the Concord (@pedroni_tommaso).

A letter came with Tobias Site: "I am Konrad Site's older brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes. Tobias Site asked to leave the runners and serve as a chaplain. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.

A round went through Tobias Site's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Severin Poopdoop of the Concord (@poopdoop0224). A letter came for Tobias Site with a ribbon tied around it. Tobias Site kept the ribbon in a tunic pocket.
facundo.peraltaa: "You're late," said the corporal when Casimir Peraltaa arrived on Day 12. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
Casimir Peraltaa found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.
Casimir Peraltaa found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
The parcel for Casimir Peraltaa contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.
Nobody heard the Hegemony raiders cut the wire. Casimir Peraltaa only heard boots on the duckboards at N-F5, then nothing but pain. Raider: Silas Giftk of the Hegemony (@giftk0).
Casimir Peraltaa returned to N-F5 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
george_mander_: Day 9: Walter "Smokes" Mander reached Q-S11 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Walter "Smokes" Mander helped stack spare sandbags at Q-S11. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

A shell hit the latrine at Q-S11. Nobody was hurt. Walter "Smokes" Mander says it was the best day of the war. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Walter "Smokes" Mander stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Walter "Smokes" Mander tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived.
Roland "Tin" Shimmapaul held the mirror while Walter "Smokes" Mander shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
Roland "Tin" Shimmapaul and Walter "Smokes" Mander found a cat in the ruins at the Ossuary Wood and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Smokes.
Zeno Tonyhuang of the Hegemony and Walter "Smokes" Mander of the Concord have carved their names into the same post in no man's land at Sorrow Copse. It is getting crowded.
Walter "Smokes" Mander and Dietrich Muhlhauser made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at Q-S11 and grazed Walter "Smokes" Mander's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Viktor "Spark" Hobbybunker of the Hegemony (@baronpapas_hobbybunker).
hansaazz: The quartermaster asked Walter "Tin" Hansaazz to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Walter "Tin" Hansaazz watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Walter "Tin" Hansaazz's bunk. He has named it Duchess.
Walter "Tin" Hansaazz had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Wendel Roma crossed it, Walter "Tin" Hansaazz fired. Wendel Roma was grazed.

Duchess the rat now waits for Walter "Tin" Hansaazz at dawn watch every morning. He shares crumbs with it. The corporal calls this desertion of rations. After the loss of Hill 304, Walter "Tin" Hansaazz helped stack spare sandbags at S-F7. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
The cook borrowed Walter "Tin" Hansaazz's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.
Duchess ran squealing out of the dugout at three in the morning. Walter "Tin" Hansaazz followed, cursing, seconds before a shell came through the roof. He owes Duchess his life.
Walter "Tin" Hansaazz has not seen Duchess for two days. He tells everyone rats come and go. He still leaves crumbs on the box.
Walter "Tin" Hansaazz thought about the people he used to know on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Walter "Tin" Hansaazz wrote to the people he used to know that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Walter "Tin" Hansaazz carried Severin Martinsatali's rifle all the way up to the Sunken Road after Severin twisted an ankle. Neither has said thank you. Neither needs to. The clerk counted the names twice. Walter "Tin" Hansaazz is number 129 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Walter "Tin" Hansaazz read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
A bullet went through Walter "Tin" Hansaazz's sleeve at S-F7 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Casimir Schradog of the Hegemony (@schradog2).
A round came through the loophole Walter "Tin" Hansaazz was watching at S-F7 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Casimir Oliverjarret of the Hegemony (@_oliverjarrett).
Walter "Tin" Hansaazz spent the day on a stretcher counting the bearers who went past. Forty-three. None of them stopped.
Walter "Tin" Hansaazz returned to S-F7 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs.

Walter "Tin" Hansaazz was on watch at S-F7 when the night raid hit. The men found Walter "Tin" Hansaazz at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Albin "Tin" Thatguy of the Hegemony (@thatguy8954).
The papers connected Ivo Hansaazz to Walter "Tin" Hansaazz. The men took longer to learn Ivo Hansaazz's own habits, but they made the effort.
Ivo Hansaazz counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Walter Cko was grazed.
kickerbob2: Bastian "Shadow" Kickerbob came up with a draft of replacements on Day 10. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it. Orders came through: Bastian "Shadow" Kickerbob is a signaller now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a bullet that missed him.

The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Bastian "Shadow" Kickerbob asked if second helpings depended on the answer. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bastian "Shadow" Kickerbob. Bastian "Shadow" Kickerbob read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into U-F13. Bastian "Shadow" Kickerbob has learned to walk bent double.

Bastian "Shadow" Kickerbob washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bastian "Shadow" Kickerbob. Bastian "Shadow" Kickerbob read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The promotion to Lance Corporal reached Bastian "Shadow" Kickerbob on a creased slip of paper. He smoothed it and put it with the letters from home. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bastian "Shadow" Kickerbob. Bastian "Shadow" Kickerbob read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Bastian "Shadow" Kickerbob read a theatre review while peeling supper. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bastian "Shadow" Kickerbob. Bastian "Shadow" Kickerbob read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Bastian "Shadow" Kickerbob tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bastian "Shadow" Kickerbob. Bastian "Shadow" Kickerbob read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Bastian "Shadow" Kickerbob saw Zeno Bfitzy freeze up on the fire step at the Bone Quarry. Shadow said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough. Bastian "Shadow" Kickerbob got a letter full of small news: a new calf, a broken gate, a wedding in the spring.

Bastian "Shadow" Kickerbob tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination. The letter for Bastian "Shadow" Kickerbob had a few coins taped inside. They would buy almost nothing here, but Bastian "Shadow" Kickerbob kept them.
neophyte_painter: Emil Painter arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying a letter he never sent and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

Blackwater Canal has been won. Emil Painter listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch. A letter from home found Emil Painter before the night shift. Emil Painter folded it small and kept it close.

A clear shot from R-R4. Emil Painter grazed Ulrich Porsche and slid back down below the parapet. A letter from home found Emil Painter before the night shift. Emil Painter folded it small and kept it close. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Emil Painter did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Emil Painter borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing. A letter from home found Emil Painter before the night shift. Emil Painter folded it small and kept it close.

Rumour reached R-R4 that the war would be over by spring. Emil Painter has heard it before. So has everyone. A letter from home found Emil Painter before the night shift. Emil Painter folded it small and kept it close.

Emil Painter dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it. A letter from home found Emil Painter before the night shift. Emil Painter folded it small and kept it close.

Fresh from training, Emil Painter still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Silas "Smokes" Cringlethepr, badly wounded. A letter from home found Emil Painter before the night shift. Emil Painter folded it small and kept it close.

Emil Painter went in with a pistol and a trench club. In the Concord trench Albin "Tin" Shoes put up a fight, but not for long. (@vinnie2shoes) The raid hit the Concord line at the darkest hour. Emil Painter fought Henrik Hunted in a trench no wider than a door. Emil Painter came home with Henrik Hunted's cap badge. (@hunted_j16) Emil Painter got a letter with a pressed leaf from the tree by the front door at home.

Two shots, one miss. The second found Leopold Porsche, badly wounded. Emil Painter cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. A short letter reached Emil Painter: everyone is well, the dog misses you. Emil Painter read the part about the dog twice.
pedroni_tommaso: Matthias Tommaso took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Matthias Tommaso wrote to a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Matthias Tommaso tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination. After the loss of Grey Mill, Matthias Tommaso helped stack spare sandbags at T-S11. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
A round went through the rim of Matthias Tommaso's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Arno Thejournal of the Hegemony (@thejournal06).
Matthias Tommaso's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at T-S11 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
Matthias Tommaso crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at T-S11 holds again.

Matthias Tommaso lent Bram Morgan a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg. Now serving as a stretcher bearer, Matthias Tommaso discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.

Matthias Tommaso went over the top with the night raiders, face black with soot. In the Hegemony trench a man turned around too late. Konrad Site did not get up again. (@conors_site) Matthias Tommaso came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot. Matthias Tommaso kept the new letter in a breast pocket all day, and touched the pocket now and then to check it was there.
Matthias Tommaso walked back up the communication trench to T-S11, slower than before, but on his own feet.
peter28.2011: Zeno "Brick" Peter was a tram conductor in Port Abel until the posters went up. He came to S-C1 with a lucky button, and within a day the whole squad knew that he is always the first one awake.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In S-C1, Zeno "Brick" Peter listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Zeno "Brick" Peter was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-C1. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Ulrich Tym of the Hegemony (@ty_m1015). A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Zeno "Brick" Peter is number 756. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Zeno "Brick" Peter stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Zeno "Brick" Peter's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at S-C1 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
Zeno "Brick" Peter took a wrong turn at two identical trench junctions. He decided the route needed names that could be remembered under pressure.
Zeno "Brick" Peter held the mirror while Severin Templar shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
Zeno "Brick" Peter marked the first junction with a spoon and the second with a boot sole. Other runners have begun using the names in their directions.

A bullet went through Zeno "Brick" Peter's upper arm at S-C1 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Quentin Oorah of the Hegemony (@oorah961). Zeno "Brick" Peter was killed on watch at S-C1. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Quentin Oorah of the Hegemony (@oorah961).
Isidor Peter took the same post at S-C1 where Zeno "Brick" Peter stood. He found his father's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.

Isidor Peter had just lit a cigarette at S-C1 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Dietrich Rudransh of the Hegemony (@11.rudransh). Isidor Peter fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Bastian Nadana was badly wounded.
servantmc7: Valentin Servantmc found a place in N-F14 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.

Valentin Servantmc felt a hard tug at his hip at N-F14. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Casimir "Ghost" Tine of the Concord (@therealgu1ll0tine).
The medic cut the last bandage off Valentin Servantmc's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to N-F14 the same hour.
Part of the parapet collapsed near Valentin Servantmc. Repairs started as soon as the dust settled, with one man on watch while the rest worked.
Valentin Servantmc traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch.
tejci_mejci66: On Day 3 Leopold Mejci took a post at S-F6 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He whistles the same four notes over and over, and the men liked him for it.

After what happened at Sorrow Copse, Leopold Mejci asked to serve as a sapper. Nobody argued. The report confirmed the Concord victory at Verdel Ridge. Leopold Mejci folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Leopold Mejci borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.
The cook's stew tasted of iron and smoke. Leopold Mejci ate two helpings anyway.

On a quiet night Leopold Mejci (Concord) and Zeno Tonyhuang (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there. Day 6. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Leopold Mejci watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Leopold Mejci counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Leopold Mejci pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.
Leopold Mejci spent the night underground, listening. Somewhere beneath the Hanging Bridge someone else was digging too.
Leopold Mejci saw Quentin Caden freeze up on the fire step at the Ossuary Wood. Leopold said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.

A round went through Leopold Mejci's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Dorian "Rabbit" Akind of the Hegemony (@akind47). The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In S-F6, Leopold Mejci listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Leopold Mejci walked back up the communication trench to S-F6, slower than before, but on his own feet. Leopold Mejci got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 183. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Leopold Mejci stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
A dog crosses no man's land at the Bone Quarry every night, fed by Leopold Mejci on one side and Gustav Naterrwaterr on the other. The Concord call it Patrol. The Hegemony call it Spy.
A shell burst over S-F6 and Leopold Mejci went down with a leg that would not hold him. The stretcher bearers came at a run.
Someone moved Leopold Mejci's stretcher out of the doorway. It was the most anyone did for him all day, and he was grateful.
Leopold Mejci never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Leopold Mejci was hit hard in the fight at S-F6 before anyone could fire. The raider was Cyril Rttr of the Hegemony. Raider: Cyril Rttr of the Hegemony (@19rttr97).
